flow: PIT market state -> hypothetical portfolio -> exposure engine -> metrics -> flags -> deterministic RiskSnapshot. No actions.

metric_value.rules: value null <=> class UNAVAILABLE <=> state in {UNAVAILABLE, INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY}; a null has a reason; class in {MEASURED, DERIVED, ASSUMED, POLICY, UNAVAILABLE}; state in RM0-QUALITY

actions: always the empty list: a snapshot never orders, sizes, halts, resumes, notifies or writes anywhere
identity: snapshot_id = sha256 of the canonical JSON (sorted keys, 12 significant digits) of the record without snapshot_id; identical inputs give byte-identical output
provenance: market data identity (dataset id, dataset.json sha256, sealed days, per-day seal sha256, reader and loader versions), RM0 contract-set sha256, P2-X v2 contract-set sha256, inputs sha256; never a host path
